integrity: Exact definitions, a complete elementary proof, a finite independent BFS verifier and explicit prior-work comparisons are provided. Independent mathematical audit and definitive publication-priority verification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only one-subdivisions of labelled complete graphs of order at least three. It is not a characterization for arbitrary subdivisions. The sufficiency of vertex covers in this high-girth setting is already known; only the converse here and exact family classifications are assessed as potentially new. The program checks finite cases and does not prove the infinite theorem.
title: Exact monitoring edge-geodetic sets of subdivided complete graphs
